name: b-failure-auto-reroute
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). The route A > B > C is installed automatically. B stops at 12 s. Neighbors time it out, reports reach the controller through D, and it installs A > D > C by itself: D first, then A.
